baseline.expectations: E08-E13 exit 75; E08 is the sole walking skeleton

roadmap.estimate_basis: E07 measured 26 seconds and needed a 386-line runner. E09's 200 journeys need 5,200 seconds (87 minutes) at that rate before E10/E13, authoring, capture, and audit. Estimate: 02-03 eight hours; total 32.
roadmap.evidence_gate: Run verification/harness/run-expectation.sh E08-E13 in the local Git checkout. Each runner owns cargo xtask metal run and returns remote output for local pinned verification.yaml, different-fox audit, and README/INDEX updates.
notes: ADR-0090/0091 govern. No new public API, runner, VM Exec probe, or lifecycle owner.
Rejected: configuration cannot remove parser rejection; one file cannot cross schema/CLI/runtime; one mega-step defeats bounded review.
Atomic RED: replace each owned panic with assertions and remove its exact should_panic marker together.
EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: proptest/state-delta where amplifiable; seeded/integration/E2E remain examples. Pure properties use exactly /// CONTRACT_SHAPE: pure-function.
Rust stays in-process; E08-E13 drive checked-in examples through the built binary, never tests or crates.
Scope lists allow related compiler/test/manifest/harness/configuration fallout. Accepted DESIGN/ADRs are read-only.

final_mutation_gate.after: All eight step reviews and E08-E13 evidence audits are approved
final_mutation_gate.command: cargo xtask lima run -- bash -lc "cargo xtask mutants --diff origin/main --features integration-tests && jq -e --argjson baseline \"\$(cat mutants-baseline/main/kill_rate.txt)\" '.status == \"pass\" and .kill_rate_pct >= 80 and .kill_rate_pct >= (\$baseline - 2)' target/xtask/mutants-summary.json"
final_mutation_gate.pass: The compound command exits 0, enforcing wrapper pass, kill rate at least 80%, and baseline drift no worse than -2 percentage points; investigate timeout/unviable outcomes.
final_mutation_gate.discipline: Run once, never per step; do not edit mutation exclusions.

phases.name: Slice 01 — TCP VM Service path
phases.description: Land atomic V3 ingress, TCP targeting, and shared VM supervision.

steps.name: Atomic ServiceSpecV3 ingress
steps.description: Cut V3 and every direct compiler consumer together, including aggregate and both CLI lanes.
criteria: ServiceSpec/Latest alias exact-field V3; V1/V2 bytes remain fixed, V2 upgrades to Exec, V3 adds one fixture, and tags equal [0,1,2].
Parser accepts exactly one driver; both ingress layers reject the first role/position VM Exec probe before persistence with exact GH #280 diagnostic and localization.
Exec/VM intent and describe preserve existing union arms; Exec Service probes remain accepted; VmNotAllowedOnServiceKind is removed.
Detached and streaming CLI lanes forward the selected union without new request shape and retain rendering/exits.
Workspace all-target compilation succeeds at the V3 alias commit; no compatibility field or accessor exists.
verification: cargo xtask lima run -- cargo nextest run -p overdrive-core -p overdrive-cli --test acceptance -E 'test(service_kind_vm_workloads)'
cargo xtask lima run -- cargo nextest run -p overdrive-core --test schema_evolution -E 'test(service_spec)'
cargo xtask lima run -- cargo check --workspace --all-targets --features integration-tests
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM; proptest pure ingress laws. V3, consumers, and S-SVM-23/24 land atomically.

steps.name: ProbeRunner TCP projection
steps.description: Adopt the accepted AllocationSpec registration API and resolve guest TCP targets once.
criteria: ProbeRunner exposes exactly start_alloc(&AllocationSpec) -> CancellationToken; the old public form is removed.
VM omitted/wildcard TCP targets use workload_addr; Exec HTTP/TCP defaults stay loopback; persisted descriptors remain unchanged.
No Vm + None behavior or test exists.
TCP Pass/Fail observations never own Running.
verification: cargo xtask lima run -- cargo nextest run -p overdrive-worker --test acceptance -E 'test(exec_default_network_probe_targets_remain_loopback) or test(vm_tcp_probe_records_guest_connect_outcome_without_owning_running)'
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM; proptest TCP projection; adapter observation stays single-example.

steps.name: VmDriver shared supervision
steps.description: Make the trusted runner mandatory for VmDriver and share one approved instance across both production drivers.
criteria: VmDriver::new is exactly (vmm, clock, fs, cgroup_accounting, probe_runner, layout), with mandatory fifth runner and no builder.
Running registers all probes; Stable stops startup only; terminal stops the supervisor.
Restart registration uses current AllocationSpec and retains one task set.
One serve boot performs one trust probe and shares its Arc without changing VM capability outcomes or Driver API.

phases.name: Slice 02 — HTTP and walking skeleton
phases.description: Extend HTTP targeting, activate E08, then run static truthfulness matrices.

steps.name: HTTP guest targeting
steps.description: Project VM HTTP targets while preserving delivered HTTP policy.
criteria: VM HTTP defaults use workload_addr; every explicit HTTP/TCP host remains byte-identical for both drivers.
2xx passes; 3xx/4xx/5xx fail numerically; redirects remain unfollowed; bodies remain bounded and hidden.
HTTP observations never own Running or add VM policy.

Readiness changes only Backend.healthy; Running/Stable persist and no restart occurs.

steps.name: E12 liveness restart

WorkloadLifecycle alone chooses restart or final failure under the existing budget.
